data.narrative:
Eikon Therapeutics is a Series B biotech company founded by Luke Lavis, Eric Betzig, Robert Tjian, and Xavier Darzacq, currently valued at $539M post-money on $1.1B+ total raised. The valuation is anchored against a comp universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including same/adjacent-stage companies like Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, implying $1.0B enterprise value. Peer-median analysis across the 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables yields $3.8B, with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied—the sector P/S median is 5.5x across biotech public names, but target revenue is not on file. Across the two applicable methods, the implied valuation band is $870M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.4B. The wide spread reflects meaningful uncertainty around commercialization trajectory and peer selection. Absent revenue disclosure or clearer stage positioning relative to the peer set, valuation support concentrates in the $1.0B–$2.4B range.
